collection.title: Mercedes-Benz A Class Hatchback 2004 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz A Class 2004 to 2012 (W169) model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 23" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this A Class, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
